( ABOUT PIXELRUSH )

NOT JUST ANOTHERCREATIVE AGENCY.

Established in 2026 and based in Chandigarh, PIXELRUSH is an independent creative marketing and design studio built around one simple belief: every pixel has a story.

We work with clubs, cafes, restaurants, event companies and lifestyle brands to transform ideas into distinctive visuals and creative experiences.

From striking event posters and brand identities to social media campaigns, motion content and digital experiences, we bring ideas to life through original thinking, purposeful design and an uncompromising eye for detail.

We don’t believe in creating just to fill a space. We believe every visual should communicate something, capture attention and leave an impression.

( THE HUMAN TOUCH )

NOT GENERATED.IMAGINED.CREATED.DESIGNED.

In a world where everything is becoming automated, we believe creativity still deserves a human touch.

At PIXELRUSH, every concept begins with an idea, every visual has a purpose, and every pixel tells a story.
